name: com.synastrycalculator/synastry
title: Synastry Calculator — Ephemeris Synastry & Compatibility Engine
description: Calculate synastry chart aspects, compatibility scores, house overlays, and sign pairings.

tools.name: calculate_synastry
tools.description: Compute ephemeris-based synastry cross-chart aspects, weighted compatibility scores (overall, attraction/shared energy, communication, emotional, long-term), best and most challenging aspects, optional house overlays, and composite chart midpoints for two birth charts.

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-02 to today), e.g. '1992-07-18'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time in HH:mm format, e.g. '14:30'. Provide together with timezone, latitude, and longitude for exact Moon, angles, and house overlays.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name for birthTime, e.g. 'America/New_York' or 'UTC'. Must be provided together with birthTime, latitude, and longitude.

latitude.description: Optional birth latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Must be provided together with birthTime, timezone, and longitude.

longitude.description: Optional birth longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Must be provided together with birthTime, timezone, and latitude.

personA.description: Birth details for the first person.

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-02 to today), e.g. '1992-07-18'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time in HH:mm format, e.g. '14:30'. Provide together with timezone, latitude, and longitude for exact Moon, angles, and house overlays.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name for birthTime, e.g. 'America/New_York' or 'UTC'. Must be provided together with birthTime, latitude, and longitude.

latitude.description: Optional birth latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Must be provided together with birthTime, timezone, and longitude.

longitude.description: Optional birth longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Must be provided together with birthTime, timezone, and latitude.

personB.description: Birth details for the second person.

mode.description: Scoring mode: 'romantic' (default) or 'friendship'. Automatically falls back to 'friendship' if either person is under 18.

houseSystem.description: House system used when exact birth time and coordinates are supplied ('placidus' or 'whole-sign').

maxAspects.description: Optional maximum number of tightest cross-chart aspects to return (1-100, default 25).

tools.name: get_zodiac_sign_compatibility
tools.description: Compute the classical sign-to-sign angular relationship (Same, Easy, Tense, Quiet), exact aspect angle, element, and modality between two tropical zodiac signs, or list all sign pairings for a single zodiac sign.

signA.description: Primary tropical zodiac sign slug, e.g. 'aries'.

signB.description: Optional second tropical zodiac sign slug, e.g. 'libra'. Omit to return all pairings grouped by harmony type.
